Author: D.Bharatha Chakravarthy Bench: D.Bharatha Chakravarthy  W.P.
 IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT MADRAS  DATED: 16.04.2024  Coram  THE HON'BLE MR JUSTICE D.BHARATHA CHAKRAVARTHY  W.P.No.9351 of 2024  M.Sankaranarayanan ... Pe  -Versus-  1.Secretary to Government,

Re  Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of I  Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents to consider the representatio  the petitioner dated 02.02.2024 and consequently directing the responden  pay additional charge allowance for working as additional charge food sa  officer to Rajakkamangalam Block, Kanniyakumari District from 26.10.2019  till date. 
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  1 of 4  W.
M.Sankaranarayanan vs Secretary To Government on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155345355/
1  For Petitioner : Mr.U.Jugal Kumar  For Respondents : Mr.M.Bindhran,
 Additional Government Pleade  ORDER This Writ Petition is filed to consider the representation of the petitioner and consequently to direct the respondents to pay the additional charge allowance for the petitioner, who is working as an additional charge Food Safety Officer. 
2. When the matter came up for hearing, the learned Additional Government Pleader appearing on behalf of the respondents would place the proceedings of the Commissioner of Food Safety and Drug Administration dated 03.04.2024. As per the said proceedings, it is stated that the Food Safety Officers mentioned in the enclosure to the said proceedings were already sanctioned with an additional charge allowance at the rate mentioned therein. 
For various periods, all the entitled officers have been sanctioned and the name of the petitioner finds place in the annexure. 
3 . I n v i e w t h e r e o f , t h e g r i e v a n c e o f t h e p e t i t i o n e r h a s b e e n r e d r e s s e d b y https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2 of 4 the said proceedings dated 03.04.2024. Recording the same, no further order needs to be passed in the Writ Petition. Accordingly, this Writ Petition stands disposed of. No costs.
